sentences.en: So our most urgent request to the president of the United States and every member of Congress is to give us the right to vote.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们向美国总统和每一位国会议员提出的最紧迫请求，就是赋予我们投票权。

sentences.zh: 在像佐治亚州这样的地方，我们在60年代和50年代就有过这样的经历。

sentences.en: Here, as in many places in the South, voter registration is designed to keep Negro voting to a minimum.
sentences.zh: 在这里，正如南方许多地方一样，选民登记制度旨在将黑人投票率降至最低。

sentences.en: It is wrong, deadly wrong, to deny any of your fellow Americans the right to vote in this country.
sentences.zh: 剥夺任何美国同胞在这个国家的投票权是错误的，大错特错。

sentences.en: Which really tries to have the federal government say, if you, in the years of 1964 through 1972,

sentences.en: And so what those states are told is that if they want to enact any type of voting laws,

sentences.en: So I said, knowing these two candidates, Kemp and Abrams, and their backstory, how much has this governor's race been shaped by the question of voting rights and voting procedures?

sentences.zh: 但在过去几周，在美联社报道有53,000名佐治亚州人，

sentences.zh: 他们已经建立了一份名单，总共有53,000名佐治亚州人。

sentences.zh: 我们知道这53,000名佐治亚州人是谁吗？

sentences.zh: 我们知道其中70%是黑人。

sentences.en: Wow.

sentences.en: ...that this is a racially motivated...

sentences.en: She was meaning, this is who we're fighting for.
sentences.zh: 她的意思是，这就是我们为之奋斗的对象。

sentences.en: I had seen the mudslinging going back and forth.
sentences.zh: 我看到了双方的相互抹黑。

sentences.en: So I just decided to go to Georgia and talk to voters and see how this was playing out on the ground.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定去佐治亚州与选民交谈，看看这种情况在实地是如何发展的。

sentences.en: I'll snow down here.

sentences.en: And we were out in Gwinnett County, which is one of the most diverse counties in Georgia, and a key spot that Democrats would need to come out and turn out for Stacey Abrams
sentences.zh: 我们在格温内特县，这是佐治亚州最多元化的县之一，也是民主党人需要动员起来为斯泰西·艾布拉姆斯投票的关键地点

sentences.en: to win.

sentences.en: But there's confusion.

sentences.en: And this year, with turnout expected to be at record highs, that may mean longer lines, and that may mean a more difficult time for these voters.

sentences.zh: 随着我们的政党变得更加两极分化，随着这种分化沿着种族界线过滤，这给了

sentences.zh: 民主党人提供便利的动力，同时也给了共和党人

sentences.en: And more importantly, it gives Brian Kemp increased ability to play out the kind of voter restrictions of his dreaMs.

sentences.en: What do you mean?
